Overview

Server Maintenance, explained

Servers run the systems your business depends on. When they slow down or fail, work stops.

We keep on-premise and cloud servers patched, monitored and backed up, plan upgrades before they become urgent, and help you move to the cloud when it makes sense.

Who it's for

  • Businesses with on-premise servers
  • Businesses running servers in the cloud
  • Teams with ageing hardware
  • Organisations considering a cloud move

Why it matters

Why Server Maintenance matters for your business

Servers run the systems your business depends on. When they slow down or fail, work stops and data is at risk.

Regular patching, monitoring and backups prevent most problems. Planning upgrades ahead avoids rushed, expensive replacements.

We maintain on-premise and cloud servers, and help you decide when moving to the cloud makes sense.

Pricing

What affects the cost of Server Maintenance

  • Number of users, devices and servers
  • Whether systems are on-premise, in the cloud, or both
  • The level of monitoring and response you need
  • Backup and recovery requirements
  • Security standards you need to meet, such as the Essential Eight

Every quote is itemised, in AUD or USD, and valid for 30 days.

Get a fixed quote

Getting started

What we'll need from you

  • A list of your systems, servers and key software
  • Admin access so we can review your setup
  • Any recent incidents or problems
  • Who in your team we should contact for approvals

Don't have all of this yet? That's fine. We'll work through it together in your free consultation.

FAQ

Server Maintenance questions

Do you support on-premise servers?

Yes, along with cloud servers.

Can you move our servers to the cloud?

Yes, when it makes sense for cost and performance.

Do you visit our site?

Most work is done remotely. On-site needs can be discussed in your quote.

Should we move to the cloud?

Not always. We'll compare cost and performance and give honest advice.

Do you patch outside business hours?

Yes, we schedule updates to avoid disrupting your team.

Do you support Windows and Linux servers?

Ask us about your server mix and we'll confirm coverage.

Can you monitor servers at multiple sites?

Yes, remotely.

What happens if a server fails?

We act quickly to restore service from backups.
